lead_headline: Vaultaire HiFi listening bar debuts beneath La Forêt today as restaurant tracker logs 7 fresh leads—40 total now active across openings (19) and closures (21)

restaurant.blurb: 7 new leads today inflate the active roster to 40 total (19 openings, 21 closures/temp closures). Today's marquee opening: Vaultaire, a subterranean HiFi listening bar, launches beneath La Forêt at 38 S Broadway—analog sound system, vintage spirits, French small plates. Also fresh: GQue BBQ opens fifth year-round location at McGregor Square's Milepost Zero, Rosie's Ice Cream relocates from Berkeley to Washington Park's Pearl Street corridor. Closure ledger expands: Whisk and Willow Bakery (home-based cottage operation) shuts West Colfax doors after 1-2 year run, Colorado Wine Tours listing actually masks Wild Women Winery's 18-year closure (2007-2025ish). Two Dairy Queen Grill & Chill locations (Regis, Fort Logan) surface as February closures, plus duplicate Safeway and California Pizza Kitchen entries confirm prior detections. Week-to-date: 7 opening leads versus 14 closure leads—attrition outpacing expansion 2:1.

foreclosure.blurb: 33 filings this week extends the deceleration pattern—down 33% from last week's 49, marking the fourth consecutive week of declining volume since late-February peak. 39 auctions scheduled next seven days, total exposure $11.1M. Douglas County's $628K Lumos Lane property tops the roster, but zero filings breached $2M for second straight week. Weld County leads active cases at 370, El Paso follows at 375. Week-over-week slide from 49→33 now tracks parallel to March 2025's seasonal pattern—spring auction surge delayed or dampened. El Paso and Weld concentrations suggest exurban distress persists while Denver metro (55 cases) remains comparatively insulated.

reputation.blurb: 9 mentions yesterday hold the 7-day total at 48 across 14 sources—still 140% above prior week's 20, but Wednesday's flat count versus Tuesday suggests the post-launch spike plateauing into steady state. Denver Post still commands 44% share (21 citations), Instagram and Facebook combine for 11 social pickups. Wednesday notables: sibling steel firm dispute coverage, tasting menu restaurant closure, RiNo coworking spot shuttering ahead of downtown debut. Google News RSS captures 47 of 48 detections—Reddit contributes lone outlier. Two-week pattern emerging: explosive 5→53 Week 1 surge now settling into 48-mention Week 2 plateau. If Thursday-Sunday hold 45-50 range, tracker's baseline velocity locks at ~7 daily mentions—legitimate earned media footprint, not launch artifact.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (3 new, 2 canceled) crawls forward for second consecutive day, nudging MTD to +12 (+1.1/day) with 90-day cumulative at +77. Past two weeks expose bifurcated momentum: catastrophic −4 plunge March 5 followed by six-day +11 recovery (March 6-11), but daily gains shrinking—6-net spike March 9 has decelerated to +3, +1, +1 since. Seven-day total of +8 trails prior week's pace, and March's 1.1/day rate lags YTD's 1.2/day benchmark. Cancellation floor stabilized at 2/day (five of last seven days), but new subscriber acquisition cooling from mid-week 8-add surge to current 3/day trickle. Pattern suggests March opened strong (net +4 March 2) but momentum fading as month matures—Q1 finish risks falling short of January-February velocity unless weekend delivers outsized adds.
